headline: Why your AI makes up answers (and how RAG fixes it)
narration: When an LLM does not know your company docs, it guesses. Retrieval-Augmented Generation fixes that by fetching real facts first.

headline: Chunk your docs and store embeddings
narration: First, you split PDFs, wikis, or code into small chunks, convert them into vectors, and store them in a database.

headline: Inject only the top matching chunks
narration: At query time, you retrieve only the top matching chunks and inject them into the prompt so the model cites real sources.

headline: Next: MCP, the USB-C port for AI tools
narration: Save this for your next RAG build, and follow DababonPro for part three on MCP.
